questions.prompt: How many grains of rice are in a standard one-kilogram bag of uncooked long-grain white rice?
reasoning: A single long-grain white rice kernel weighs approximately 0.02 grams.
Dividing 1000 grams by 0.02 grams per grain yields 50000 grains.

questions.prompt: How many complete orbits does the International Space Station make around Earth in a single year?
reasoning: The International Space Station takes roughly 90 minutes to complete one orbit around Earth.
There are 24 hours in a day, meaning 16 orbits are completed each day.
Multiplying 16 orbits per day by 365 days in a year gives 5840 orbits.

questions.prompt: How many sheets of standard A4 paper stacked flat on top of each other would reach a height of one kilometre?
reasoning: A standard sheet of 80 gsm A4 paper has a thickness of approximately 0.1 millimetres.
One kilometre is equal to 1000000 millimetres.
Dividing 1000000 millimetres by 0.1 millimetres per sheet gives 100000 sheets.
